item.title: Scavland
item.description:
Title: Scavland
Genre: Action , Adventure , Indie , RPG , Early Access
Developer: NoShadow
Publisher: NoShadow , UNSUBSCRIBE
Release Date: Sep 4, 2026
Early Access Release Date: Sep 4, 2026




About This Game

SURVIVE THE WORLD OF SCAVLAND

Scavland is a hardcore survival RPG set in Zalesye, a land ravaged by war and the mysterious Mist.

You are a Vulture - a scavenger surviving on what the old world left behind. Explore abandoned settlements, take dangerous jobs, fight mutants and hostile survivors, and slowly build the equipment and reputation you need to push deeper into the wastes.

Ammunition is scarce, weapons can jam, radiation is everywhere, and preparation can mean the difference between returning with valuable loot or not returning at all.

FIND YOUR PLACE

Zalesye is home to different factions, settlements, traders, scavengers, and survivors, each trying to make a life in what remains of the world.

Meet their people, take quests, build relationships, and decide who you are willing to work with. Your reputation and choices shape how different groups treat you and what opportunities become available.

Some are trying to rebuild society. Others are simply trying to survive it.

EXPLORE ABOVE AND BELOW

Explore a handcrafted open world filled with abandoned structures, dangerous forests, irradiated swamps, hidden locations, mutants, bandits, and remnants of the old world.

But the surface is only part of Scavland.

Discover entrances to underground bunkers and other dangerous locations featuring procedural layouts, creating different spaces to explore across your playthroughs.

The further you leave the safety of known roads and settlements, the greater the danger - and the better the potential rewards.

BUILD YOUR WEAPONS

Weapons are more than something you find and replace.

Collect firearms and attachments throughout the world and customize them to fit your needs. Change components, experiment with different configurations, and build weapons around your preferred playstyle.

Your equipment defines how prepared you are for the journey ahead. Build your loadout around where you are going, what you expect to encounter, and how much you are willing to risk.

WORK. TRADE. BUILD A REPUTATION.

Survival depends on more than what you can find in the wastes.

Traders offer weapons, equipment, attachments, supplies, and other valuable goods - but their best stock has to be earned.

Take jobs, complete requests, and build your reputation with the people of Zalesye. As your relationship improves, new items and opportunities become available.

Every expedition becomes part of a larger cycle:

Prepare. Explore. Scavenge. Survive. Return. Upgrade. Go deeper.

UNCOVER THE MYSTERY OF THE MIST

You survived being near-fatally shot by mysterious soldiers said to have come from a far-away land with no Mist.

Now you want answers.

The people of Zalesye speak of the East as a promised land beyond the RO-29 Highway - somewhere untouched by the Mist and the horrors consuming the Continent.

Whether those stories are true is another question.

Explore Zalesye, follow its stories, help its inhabitants, and uncover what the Mist is - and why you survived when you should have died.

Mature Content Description

The developers describe the content like this:

This game includes mild depictions of violence and strong language. Players will encounter simple dismemberment of creatures, blood splatter when shooting enemies, and occasional swearing during combat or dialogue with NPCs. There are no depictions of sexual content, drug use, or self-harm in the game.



System Requirements

Windows

    Minimum:
    • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
    • OS: Windows 10
    • Processor: Intel 2.77GHz Quad-core
    • Memory: 8 GB RAM
    • Graphics: Dedicated graphics card with 2 GB of RAM minimum, OpenGL 2.1 and GLSL 1.2 support (generally 2012 or newer)
    • DirectX: Version 11
    • Storage: 2 GB available space
    • Sound Card: FMOD compatible sound card
    Recommended:
    • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
    • OS: Windows 10
    • Processor: Intel 2.77GHz Quad-core
    • Memory: 12 GB RAM
    • Graphics: Dedicated graphics card with 2 GB of RAM minimum, OpenGL 2.1 and GLSL 1.2 support (generally 2012 or newer)
    • DirectX: Version 11
    • Storage: 2 GB available space
    • Sound Card: FMOD compatible sound card

item.title: Withering Realms
item.description:
Title: Withering Realms
Genre: Action , Indie , RPG , Early Access
Developer: Moonless Formless
Publisher: Moonless Formless
Release Date: Sep 4, 2026
Early Access Release Date: Sep 4, 2026




About This Game

It is 1926, ten years after an immense “occult event” halted the Great War and transformed the world overnight. The dead walk, spirits roam, and a gifted few can even cast spells.

9-year-old Clover awakens alone in a decaying mansion just miles from the epicenter of the occult event, and soon discovers that she is a ghost.

Her only companion is a strange and powerful doll constructed from wood, metal, and human remains.

In this Horror Action RPG from the creator of Withering Rooms , join Clover and her doll guardian as they explore the mysterious town of Penwyll and the sprawling graveyards that surround it, seeking a way to bring her back to life.

  • Descend into tombs, caves and rotting estates in search of treasure, upgrade materials and magical artifacts

  • Craft weapons and machines to slot into the doll’s missing right arm like the Enchanted Candelabrum, Chain Rock, Machinegun, or Flamethrower

  • Expand the world map by defeating massive perimeter guardians

  • Make allies such as the daring freelance investigator Althea who will do anything to uncover Penwyll's dark secret including interrogation, lockpicking and forgery

  • Return to any area at night to encounter new, horrifying creatures and secrets

item.title: Worming from Home
item.description:
Title: Worming from Home
Genre: Action , Adventure , Casual , Indie , Simulation
Developer: Zach Northrop , Mason Sabharwal
Publisher: Zach Northrop
Release Date: Sep 4, 2026




About This Game

Wriggle your way up the corporate ladder in Worming from Home, a job sim where you’re a worm. Throw your spineless body around the keyboard to answer messages and fill out spreadsheets in your role as a junior financial analyst. Upgrade, invest, and finally earn that promotion!

Experience state of the art ragdoll physics as you soar across your desk, just like a real life worm. Bash your head against the keys to convince your boss that you're actually doing work. Use insider information to illegally game the stock market. Answer the phone occasionally. It's just like any corporate job, only... wormier.

Of course, there’s more to life than making money. Spend your free time getting swole in the gym, reading the latest self-help books, shopping for trinkets, or flirting with your coworkers. Buy upgrades to make your wormy life easier, or buy a bunch of hats. You deserve a little treat :)

item.title: Retro Arcade Shop Simulator
item.description:
Title: Retro Arcade Shop Simulator
Genre: Indie , Simulation , Early Access
Developer: Alt Tab Game
Publisher: Ultimate Publishing , Ultimate Games S.A. , PlayWay S.A.
Franchise: PlayWay S.A. , Ultimate Games S.A.
Release Date: Sep 4, 2026
Early Access Release Date: Sep 4, 2026




About This Game

Build and manage your ultimate retro arcade! Buy classic Arcade Machines, Galaxy Pinball, and Gift Claw games, or invest in Cinema 8D, Go-Karts, and Racing Simulators. Manage the economy, hire staff, and keep every machine running!

Build Your Arcade Empire

Step into the neon-lit world of the past and build the ultimate entertainment center in Retro Arcade Shop Simulator. Start with a humble, dusty venue and gradually transform it into a booming, large-scale arcade business. Buy nostalgic arcade cabinets, organize your floor plan to maximize customer flow, and watch the tokens roll in. Whether you want to recreate a cozy 80s hangout spot or build a massive, multi-room gaming paradise, you have the tools to bring your retro tycoon dreams to life.

Manage a Growing Business

Growing your business takes more than plugging in a few machines. You’ll need to manage a token economy across four different currencies, watch your hourly income, and take out bank loans to fund your expansions.

Unlock up to 10 unique rooms and fill them with a variety of attractions. Offer your customers classic Air Hockey, Pinball, and Whack-A-Mole, or invest in high-end Plane Simulators, Bowling Alleys, Go-Kart tracks, and immersive 8D Cinemas. When crowds get overwhelming, hire cashiers, cafeteria workers, and token collectors so no customer ever waits in line.

Customize Your Neon Haven

Make the arcade truly yours with deep interior customization. Choose from dozens of wall and floor textures, add vibrant graffiti murals, and set the perfect mood with neon lighting, signs, and decorative plants. You’ll also need to keep your customers fueled by managing a cafeteria - serve burgers, pour drinks, and sell gaming magazines or CDs to maximize your daily profits.

Keep Every Machine Running

Heavy use takes its toll. Cabinets break down, screens go dark, and a dead machine is a machine that isn't making you money. Service and repair your hardware, mop the floors, empty the token boxes, and keep the whole venue in working order. Do it all yourself to save money in the early days, then hire repairmen and cleaners once the crowds get too big to handle alone. Blend relaxing business progression with an unforgettable nostalgic atmosphere and become the ultimate arcade tycoon!

Key Features

  • Build Your Arcade Empire
    Expand from a small shop into a massive entertainment center by unlocking 10 distinct rooms.

  • Over 25 Unique Machines & Attractions
    Build your dream venue with 28 distinct types of entertainment, ranging from classic Arcade Cabinets, Pinball, and Whack-A-Mole to high-end Plane Simulators, Go-Karts, and 8D Cinemas

  • Service & Repair
    Machines wear down with use. Keep them serviced and repaired, mop the floors, and collect the tokens to keep your arcade profitable.

  • Deep Economy Management
    Navigate a complex financial system with 4 token types, hourly income tracking, and multi-tier bank loans.

  • Automate with Staff
    Hire and manage cashiers, cafeteria workers, repairmen, cleaners, and token collectors to keep your business running smoothly.

  • Extensive Customization
    Personalize your venue with 26 wall textures, 17 floor types, custom lighting, posters, neon signs, and decorative plants.

  • Run a Cafeteria
    Keep gamers fueled by serving snacks and drinks, and boost your profits by selling video games, comics, and magazines.

AI Generated Content Disclosure

The developers describe how their game uses AI Generated Content like this:

AI was used as an assistive tool for creating specific texture patterns, supporting code development, and producing videos for the game. All generated content was manually reviewed, edited, and refined by our team.

As a small independent game studio, we use AI to support our creative workflow. All final content was created and approved by our team.



System Requirements

Windows

    Minimum:
    • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
    • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
    • Processor: Intel Core i3-14100F or AMD Ryzen 5 5560U
    • Memory: 8 GB RAM
    • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 or AMD Radeon RX 5600
    • DirectX: Version 11
    • Storage: 8 GB available space
    • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible
    • Additional Notes: LOW Quality / 60FPS / 1920x1080. SSD Required.
    Recommended:
    • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
    • OS: Windows 11 (64-bit)
    • Processor: Intel Core i5-12600K or AMD Ryzen 5 7600X
    • Memory: 16 GB RAM
    • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2070 Super or AMD Radeon RX 6600 XT
    • DirectX: Version 11
    • Storage: 8 GB available space
    • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible
    • Additional Notes: High Quality / 60FPS / 1920x1080. SSD Required.

item.title: Dungeon Settlers
item.description:
Title: Dungeon Settlers
Genre: Simulation , Strategy , Early Access
Developer: CanOpener
Publisher: CanOpener , WhisperGames
Release Date: Sep 4, 2026
Early Access Release Date: Sep 4, 2026




About This Game

Dungeon Settlers is a dark fantasy strategy game that combines colony simulation and dungeon crawling. As the leader of an expedition sent by the Guild, your mission is to explore, conquer, and destroy the dungeon which is the source of all calamities. To do so, you’ll need to build a settlement in the barren land and prepare your people for the dangers ahead.

This is a ‘Hardcore Strategy’ game. Train your members strategically by considering their equipment, skills, and traits, then form a party of up to four. In real-time with pause tactical combat with no turn or round limits, analyze enemy traits and patterns to outmaneuver them and achieve victory. But remember once dead, there is no coming back...

Build a settlement in the desolate land, isolated by magical erosion. Design rooms freely by placing walls and doors to meet your members’ needs—create bedrooms and dining areas, and set up a forge with anvils and smelters. Cultivate fields to grow crops. Manage your resources efficiently to survive, and produce rations and camping supplies for the next expedition. Unlock new buildings and equipment through research.

Each member has six major abilities and talents, along with dozens of combat and life-related stats. They also possess various traits based on race, background, and personality—such as a curious Lizardman with a drifter’s past. Recruit promising candidates and help them grow through leveling. Equip them with powerful equipments and carefully build a four-member expedition party with synergistic skill trees such as sword/mace/bow/fire magic.

Combat takes place in real time, but you can pause at any moment to think strategically. Plan your tactics using a variety of effects and mechanics—stun, bleed, burn, provoke, vulnerable, charge attacks, summons, and more. Position your party wisely, exploit enemy weaknesses, and utilize your skills at the right time. Even hopeless battles can be overcome with the right strategy.

Each dungeon expedition is randomly composed, with floors and rooms changing each time. Regions apply different random environmental effects. The deeper you go, the rarer and more valuable the resources become—but so do the threats. You’ll encounter the remnants of magical experiments, such as towering golems or acid-spitting monsters. Secure wood logs, herbs, gemstone veins, and mysterious mandrake. Trade with dungeon merchants, and face ancient tree that demand blood to bear forbidden fruit.

AI Generated Content Disclosure

The developers describe how their game uses AI Generated Content like this:

Generative AI was used for the game's localization. Some languages were translated or reviewed by human translators.



System Requirements

Windows

MacOS
